Day 05 | Turn Ordinary Photos into Beautiful Oil Painting Posters

One prompt a day. Endless creative possibilities.

What if your everyday photos could become beautiful, hand-painted magazine covers?

Today, I’m sharing one of my favorite AI image transformations:

Real Photography × Impasto Oil Painting × Summer Editorial Design

No painting skills. No complicated editing.

Just one photo and one detailed prompt.

I tried it with four different scenes:

🌊 Mediterranean Escape — A sunny coastal village transformed into a vibrant oil painting.

🍒 Slow Summer Days — A peaceful picnic reimagined as a nostalgic summer illustration.

🍋 Lemon Weekend — A bright café table turned into a textured lifestyle poster.

🌸 A Gentle Morning — A flower-filled street transformed into a romantic painted scene.

Same technique. Four completely different results.

And here’s the best part: you can try it with your own photos.

⸻

THE FULL PROMPT (Copy & Paste)

Using the uploaded photograph as the primary visual reference, create a premium 3:4 vertical editorial art poster featuring a realistic photograph and its artistic oil painting transformation.

COMPOSITION

Divide the canvas into two equal horizontal sections, each occupying exactly 50% of the total height.

Do not add borders, collage frames, tape, torn paper effects, or decorative separators between the sections.

TOP SECTION — ORIGINAL PHOTOGRAPH

Preserve the original photograph as faithfully as possible.

Maintain the subject’s identity, composition, position, proportions, colors, lighting, perspective, and overall atmosphere.

Do not add, remove, replace, or significantly alter important objects.

Only subtle color correction and natural image extension are permitted.

BOTTOM SECTION — OIL PAINTING TRANSFORMATION

Recreate the same scene as a sophisticated impasto oil painting.

Use thick, expressive palette-knife strokes, visible paint texture, layered pigments, and authentic canvas-like details.

Preserve the recognizable shapes, spatial relationships, and important elements of the original photograph.

Allow natural brushstrokes to extend into a warm, cream-colored paper background, creating an elegant, handcrafted artistic effect.

ART DIRECTION

Inspired by summer travel magazines, contemporary editorial illustration, Mediterranean color palettes, and premium gallery prints.

Use vibrant yet harmonious colors, expressive textures, and carefully balanced negative space.

Add one original, expressive English headline to the bottom section, along with a few subtle editorial annotations.

Typography should complement the artwork without distracting from the main subject.

QUALITY REQUIREMENTS

High resolution, detailed brushwork, natural lighting, realistic depth, sophisticated color harmony, and professional editorial composition.

Avoid cartoon aesthetics, plastic textures, excessive saturation, distorted objects, duplicated subjects, unnecessary decorations, and watermarks.

The final result should feel like a beautiful, handcrafted oil painting featured in an independent art and travel magazine.

⸻

RAVEN’s Tips

• Use photos with clear subjects and interesting colors.

• Travel scenes, cafés, food, flowers, and summer still lifes work especially well.

• If the AI changes important details, add:

“Preserve the original composition, object count, proportions, and spatial relationships. Apply artistic transformation only to the lower section.”

• Generate each photo separately for better control.

🍋 柠檬周末 —— 明亮的咖啡馆桌面变成富有肌理的生活方式海报。

🌸 温柔的清晨 —— 花团锦簇的街道被变身为浪漫的手绘场景。

同样的技法。四个完全不同的结果。

而最棒的部分是：你可以用自己的照片来尝试。

⸻

完整提示词（复制粘贴）

以已上传的照片作为主要视觉参考，制作一张高端的 3:4 竖版编辑风格艺术海报，呈现一张写实照片及其油画艺术变体。

构图

将画布分为两个相等的水平部分，每部分恰好占据总高度的 50%。

不要添加边框、拼贴框、胶带、撕纸效果或任何装饰性分隔线。

上半部分 —— 原始照片

尽可能忠实地保留原始照片。

保持主体的身份、构图、位置、比例、色彩、光线、透视和整体氛围。

不要添加、移除、替换或显著改动重要的物件。

仅允许轻微的色彩校正和自然的画面延展。

下半部分 —— 油画变体

将同一场景重新创作为一幅精致的厚涂油画。

使用厚重而富有表现力的调色刀笔触、可见的颜料肌理、层叠的色彩以及真实的画布质感细节。

保留原始照片中可识别的形状、空间关系和重要元素。

允许自然的笔触延伸至温暖的米白色纸张背景，营造优雅的手工艺术效果。

艺术指导

灵感来源于夏日旅行杂志、当代编辑插画、地中海色彩搭配以及高端画廊级艺术微喷输出。

使用明快而和谐的色彩、富有表现力的肌理，以及精心平衡的留白。

在下半部分添加一句原创且富有表现力的英文标题，并配以几处细微的编辑性注释文字。

排版应与 artwork 相得益彰，同时不喧宾夺主，转移对主体的注意力。

质量要求

高分辨率、精细的笔触、自然的光线、真实的景深、高雅的色彩和谐，以及专业的编辑构图。

避免卡通风格、塑料质感、过度饱和、变形的物件、重复的主体、多余的装饰和水印。

最终效果应像一幅精美的手工油画，刊登在独立艺术与旅行杂志上。

⸻

RAVEN 的小贴士

• 使用主体清晰、色彩有趣的照片。

• 旅行场景、咖啡馆、美食、花卉和夏日静物尤其适合。

• 如果 AI 改动了重要细节，请添加：

“保留原始构图、物件数量、比例和空间关系。仅将艺术变体应用于下半部分。”

• 每张照片分别生成，以便更好地控制效果。
